Name: Abigail Chroma
Author: MalachXaviel
Description:
Made this some time ago, forgot to upload it. Started out as a simple re-texture to fix the bow and then I went crazy. 

To Install:
Go into your Stardew Valley main directory
For the portrait install the contents of the Portraits folder into: Stardew Valley (or game DIR)\Content\Portraits

For the sprite install the contents of the Characters folder into: Stardew Valley (or game DIR)\Content\Characters

I recommend backing up both folders

-MX
